description: A classic American Colonial-style home exterior photographed at standing eye-level with a normal lens in a centered symmetrical composition that places the front entry portico squarely in the middle of the frame. Wrought iron railings with simple scroll details flank both sides of the staircase in matte black. Flanking the entry, a pair of neatly trimmed upright arborvitae evergreen trees anchor the composition, while ornamental grasses and low shrubs fill the foreground beds. The color palette is crisp and traditional: white, deep forest green, warm brick red, and touches of black metal. Diffuse overcast daylight illuminates the scene evenly, eliminating harsh shadows and giving the facade a clean, formal quality. A soft warm glow filters through the transom window from within, suggesting an interior presence. The mood is formal, welcoming, and classically restrained — quintessential New England in character.
